metadata.title: Service Bus and ESB

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing centralized integration mediation while constraining privilege concentration and systemic risk.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Enterprise service buses, integration hubs, mediation engines, message routing and transformation infrastructure.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting pattern defining centralized mediation as a high‑impact trust surface requiring explicit boundaries and non‑equivalence.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines routing, transformation, and mediation decisions as operational data, not as authorization or business trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Controls governing system interconnections, privilege management, and auditability in centralized platforms (AC, PL, AU families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that mediation and aggregation increase risk and require explicit trust boundaries.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance for logging and auditing mediation, routing, and transformation decisions.

metadata.remarks: Service Bus and ESB governs centralized integration architectures where routing, transformation, or orchestration is performed by an intermediary. This pattern explicitly recognizes the bus as a privilege concentration point and does not grant authorization, correctness, or trust inheritance to mediated messages.

components.title: Central Mediation Boundary
components.description: Defines the service bus or ESB as a distinct trust boundary between integrating systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of implicit trust in centralized mediation infrastructure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit trust boundary declaration prevents silent privilege escalation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow is explicitly controlled at mediation points.

components.title: Privilege Concentration Control
components.description: Constrains the accumulation of authority within centralized integration platforms.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit privilege constraints prevent implicit elevation through aggregation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least privilege is enforced for mediation and routing functions.

components.title: Mediation Transparency
components.description: Provides visibility into routing, transformation, and orchestration decisions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Transparency enables detection of misuse or misconfiguration.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mediation and routing actions are auditable.

components.title: Bus Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what mediation by a service bus does not grant or imply.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Non‑equivalence guarantees prevent over‑trust of centralized mediation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Routing or transformation by a bus does not imply authorization, correctness, or approval.
